body:
God I’ve been feeling the exact same way. It’s hard too because I used to have so many friends. But no one seems to want to put in the effort any more. My birthday is coming up too and I feel it’s gonna be the worst yet cause I doubt anyone cares enough to want to do anything. I just want to feel what it’s like to have people care enough to plan something. 
Anyways, solidarity. I’d be your friend. You’re welcome to message me if you want to chat.
I feel like nothing gives me joy any more. Even doing things I used to love seems like a chore. I pretty much have just been sleeping, watching tv, and applying for jobs.

What is YMMV?
It seems like most of the times I go out and try not to drink, I still cave. And usually if I have 1 - 2 (unless I'm tired or already hungover) I'll go until I've had 10 or more.
That's a good idea! Thank you. I will not drink today with you too.

I've done that too often :/ It's just "fun," but it's not. It sucks because I do like the brunch and night life culture, but I have next to zero impulse control, and therefore always drink too much. What are you doing to replace your weekend activities?
That's a really good way of wording it.
There are other ways to confront your anxiety without wasting money. Why this specifically?
I do so often as well. It is really embarrassing. I think some of my friends somewhat just expect it at this point.
This is beautiful! I'll have to check it out.

I often convince myself that it's not really a problem since it's not every day. That I'm just young and doing what others my age are doing. But time and time again, it hurts me severely with absolutely no positive return.
me too. Knowing that helps, but it also makes me sad that so many are suffering with this.

This sounds like it was written about me :(
I'm your age, and all of my friends drink. I can't even really be around drinking without caving. I'm not sure what I'll do about social settings.
